verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm API-driven creation of deposit/wallet accounts via FBO bank-partner structures (unit-docs-1, unit-docs-12, unit-docs-6, unit-docs-7), supporting the 'application to active account' programmatic flow, but the evidence never explicitly states the accounts are FDIC-insured nor describes a sandbox environment for pre-launch testing, and probes show no accessible API/OpenAPI docs (unit-probe-2, unit-probe-3) to verify sandbox parity. missing for 10: explicit insured-deposit language, sandbox/test-environment documentation, and confirmed public API reference for the account-creation flow.
